title: Filling of 9 (Nine) vacant post of Scientific Officer (6-UR, 2-OBC, 1-SC) (Pay band 3, Grade Pay Rs. 5400)
bodyHtml:
SUB: Filling of 9 (Nine) vacant post of Scientific Officer (6-UR, 2-OBC, 1-SC) (Pay band 3; Grade Pay Rs. 5400/-)- reg.

In continuation of declaration of Preliminary Qualifying Written Examination for the post of Scientific Officer held on 14-05-2017. It is intimated that the processes of short listing of qualified/eligible candidates for the next stage of selection process is in progress. [List Enclosed]

In order to confirm the caste based reservation claims of shortlisted candidates (SC and OBC only) (as per list attached) all concerned are directed to send the scanned copy of their, as on date valid, Certificate issued by the competent authority at email (ipclab@vsnl.net) latest by 9th June 2017, failing which the candidates may lose the benefit their caste based reservation.

Eligibility list for participation in Final Written Exams (Please Click)PDF (opens in a new tab)
